skill.name: Oracle DB
skill.description: Write Oracle SQL and PL/SQL with proper syntax, hints, and performance patterns.
skill.summary: Syntax Differences - `ROWNUM` for limiting rows—`WHERE ROWNUM <= 10`; 12c+ supports `FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY` - `DUAL` table for expressions—`SELECT sysdate FROM dual` - `VARCHAR2` not `VARCHAR`—VARCHAR is reserved, VAR
